# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Camp Last Laugh: Masked-Lake Survival` as a browser-native, portrait-first top-down survival action game. Preserve the source mechanic truth: the player moves freely through a bounded world with joystick/keyboard controls, collects nearby tools with GRAB, attacks in a facing-direction arc with STRIKE, is chased by spawning enemies, loses one of three hearts on contact, scores 100 points for each defeated enemy, can restart after failure, and maintains a persistent item discovery log.

The authored remix world is a satirical summer-camp slasher night. The player is the Final Counselor, hazards are relentless Lake Mask echoes, pickups are improvised escape props, score is the panic log, HP is courage, and the collection index is the contraband log. The scene should be procedurally owned by pines, cabins, lake fog, camp signs, campfire amber, VHS scratches, mask motifs, and mobile-readable HUD panels. Do not introduce new gameplay rules; express novelty through focal identity, procedural visuals, copy, sound tone, and mobile UX polish.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a single-file Canvas top-down survival action game. The player moves inside a 2500x2500 bounded world, grabs collectible weapons/tools, strikes directional attacks, avoids or defeats pursuing enemies, and loses when three hit points are depleted. Score increases by 100 on each enemy defeat. A collection journal persists discovered items. The runtime supports menu, journal, active play, game over, restart, keyboard input, and mobile pointer controls.

## Protected mechanics
- Free top-down movement with joystick/keyboard input, acceleration, friction, max speed, and camera follow.
- GRAB picks up the nearest eligible item within the original range.
- STRIKE uses the held item or bare hands with original reach/damage/cooldown/knockback semantics.
- Pursuers spawn at world edges, chase the player, damage on contact, and are knocked back.
- Three-hit failure, invulnerability window after damage, +100 score on kill, item drop chance, and persistent discovery index.
- Source state flow: menu, collection index, playing, game over, restart/menu return.

## Remixed target
`Camp Last Laugh: Masked-Lake Survival` reinterprets the same loop as a satirical camp slasher night. The player is the Final Counselor, enemies are Lake Mask echoes, items are improvised camp props, score is the panic log, HP is courage, and the journal becomes the contraband log.

## Safe transformation surfaces
Copy, HUD labels, item names/icons/colors, procedural canvas art, menu styling, background motifs, particles, feedback language, audio tone, and font usage are safe to transform. Numeric gameplay logic and input semantics are not changed.

## Mobile-first target
The game is optimized for portrait screens in the 4:7 to 9:16 range with large start/restart CTAs, bottom-corner joystick/action zones, compact HUD cards, and overlays that do not block active controls.
